title: Baby Sitting in Grass, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot photo taken on June 17, 1951, capturing a baby named Stevie sitting on a grassy lawn outdoors. The background features open fields, a distant tree line, utility lines across the sky, and the corner of a brick structure. The photograph represents typical post-war suburban childhood imagery during the peak of the American baby boom era.
